name: Terrarium 80x50x80 + AQUARIUM
label: Large terrarium
lead: Terrarium 80x50x80 cm with an integrated aquarium in the lower section. A unique combined system for a land and a water section, made of quality glass in our workshop in Novi Sad.
imageAlt: Terrarium 80x50x80 with integrated aquarium - NS Reptiles

description.html: This model combines two units in an 80x50x80 cm enclosure: a terrarium on top, and an aquarium built into the lower part. The base is 80x50 cm, the total volume about 320 liters. Both parts are visible from the front, so you get a land scene and a water scene in one piece of furniture.

The upper, terrarium part is set up with branches and plants, and the lower part is filled with water like an ordinary aquarium. Choose the species for the upper part according to its actual height, which is less than the total 80 cm. Because of the water in the lower part, humidity in the terrarium is higher, which does not suit desert species such as the bearded dragon. Filled, it is heavy, so it stands on a solid floor or a reinforced cabinet.

We set the ratio of terrarium to aquarium height according to what you plan to keep in each part. We also make it in other lengths. Let us know the species and where it will be placed, and the build takes 7 to 14 days. We cover the outer surfaces with film in the pattern you choose, as on the other models.
